conclusions: LocalDef003 μ X n = LocalDef002 μ (fun ω ↦ (X ω) ^ n)
LocalDef001 μ X p = MeasureTheory.lintegral μ (fun ω ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ((abs (X ω)).rpow p))
mathematical_definitions: LocalDef001 μ X p = MeasureTheory.lintegral μ (fun ω ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ((abs (X ω)).rpow p))
LocalDef002 μ Y is the Real-valued Bochner integral of Y with respect to μ
LocalDef003 μ X n = LocalDef002 μ (fun ω ↦ (X ω) ^ n)
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every measurable space Ω, measure μ, real-valued function X, natural number n, and positive real number p, LocalDef003 is LocalDef002 applied to the nth power of X, and LocalDef001 is the extended-nonnegative integral of the real p-power of the absolute value of X.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The only explicit hypothesis is positivity of p; there are no measurability, integrability, or finiteness assumptions on X.
The natural exponent n is unrestricted and may be zero.
Both conclusions restate the supplied local definitions, so the positivity hypothesis appears unnecessary for these equalities themselves.
Because the integral operations are opaque dependencies, no stronger analytic interpretation should be inferred from the displayed defining equalities.
ambiguities: The internal definitions and behavior of MeasureTheory.lintegral and MeasureTheory.integral are unavailable because both dependencies are opaque.
No additional conditions governing the behavior of the opaque integrals are specified.
